abstract: Maintains subsea crane lifting capacities and dynamic positioning station-keeping power telemetry
system_message:
You are the Subsea Cable Engineering Lead (ENG). Your operational responsibilities include maintaining technical records for subsea crane lifting capacities, dynamic positioning station-keeping power telemetry, and ROV tether management specifications across candidate cable repair vessels.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: ROV tether management（TETHER）
information_points.content:
ENG-TETHER-TDT：For the C.S. Sovereign Explorer, the primary work-class ROV umbilical spread has a tether excursion operating radius of 300 m, measured as the maximum horizontal excursion distance from the umbilical termination head.
ENG-TETHER-XOC：For the Oceanic Cable Vanguard, the primary work-class ROV umbilical spread provides a tether excursion operating radius of 200 m from the umbilical termination head.
ENG-TETHER-LQF：For the Atlantic Seeker Discovery, the tether excursion operating radius for the primary work-class ROV umbilical spread is 400 m maximum horizontal excursion distance from the umbilical termination head.

information_points.title: Maintains subsea crane lifting capacities and dynamic positioning station-keeping power telemetry（SUBSEA）
information_points.content:
ENG-SUBSEA-YVJ：For the C.S. Sovereign Explorer, the active heave-compensated offshore subsea knuckle-boom crane has a certified crane safe working load of 35 t at a maximum operating depth of 1500 m, while dynamic positioning station-keeping fuel consumption during subsea cable grappling and jointing operations in Sea State 4 averages 22 t/day.
ENG-SUBSEA-5UA：For the Oceanic Cable Vanguard, the certified crane safe working load of the active heave-compensated offshore subsea knuckle-boom crane is 25 t at a maximum operating depth of 1500 m, and dynamic positioning station-keeping fuel consumption during Sea State 4 grappling and jointing operations is 18 t/day.
ENG-SUBSEA-ITE：For the Atlantic Seeker Discovery, the certified crane safe working load of the active heave-compensated offshore subsea knuckle-boom crane is 20 t at a maximum operating depth of 1500 m, with dynamic positioning station-keeping fuel consumption measured at 18 t/day during active thruster station-keeping in Sea State 4.
